summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, providing a development update and financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and an operating and financial review. Revenues were €118.1 million, net loss was €531.9 million, and loss per share was €2.10. The report contains no announcement of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a Form 10-Q filing under U.S. GAAP. No special-situation category applies.
